title: Best Suitcase Set (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selections were based on the number of sources that mentioned each product and the specific features highlighted in those sources. The sites used were PCMag, The New York Times, Tom’s Guide, CNET, Good Housekeeping, and Jordan Outside.
assumptions: Prices are omitted because none of the sources provide them.
